catalysts.headline: Shares continued higher in premarket trading two sessions after the Q3 print, picked up by retail-aggregator coverage

Tandy Leather reported a sharp turnaround in third-quarter (2026) profitability, per aggregator coverage; specific figures not independently located this session (Q3 2025 a year earlier had shown a $1.4M net loss)

Q3 2026 results (quarter ended 2026-09-30): revenue $18.5M (+7.3% YoY from $17.3M); net income $0.5M vs net loss $1.4M a year earlier; EPS $0.06 vs $(0.17); operating income $0.6M; adjusted EBITDA $0.9M; gross margin 62.4% (up from 58.9%); cash fell to $5.7M from $16.1M at 12/31/25, mainly reflecting a $6.0M dividend paid in Q1 2026 plus inventory/store investment
catalysts.impact: Swing to profitability after a year-ago loss

notes: One third-party analyst (Panabee) argues a non-recurring tariff refund drove ~270bps of the gross-margin improvement, implying underlying operating-margin expansion is more modest than the headline suggests — flagged as outside commentary, not company disclosure.
